quote: Six days in the Bitterroot with the Ridgeline over a fleece mid. Never touched the puffy. The hood clears a cap without craning.
name: Dane R.

quote: The 800g Foothold is the first boot I have worn that keeps my feet warm sitting still in a Dakota layout blind. Three seasons on the pair.
name: Marcy L.

quote: Dialed the Nightfall down to the low setting for a two-mile walk-in through cedar, then opened it up to scan the field edge. One light for both.
name: Cole B.
